digest.component_or_area: CI workflows and Git fetch optimization
propositions: CI ticket-store fetches must apply --filter=blob:none to reduce transfer size and time across all checkout mechanisms (actions/checkout and direct git fetch URLs)
Workflow guard blocks must parse git count-objects output and enforce pack size limits (102400 KiB standalone, 131072 KiB Gerrit) immediately after materialization
Git protocol negotiation must advertise filter capability and send filter blob:none requests in both named-remote inheritance and direct URL fetch paths, leaving historical blobs missing
Real-Git fixture must start a local git daemon with uploadpack.allowFilter enabled and verify missing-blob behavior through GIT_TRACE_PACKET protocol inspection
Identity scanning jobs must snapshot git count-objects before and after materialization and fail if any objects are added during the verify-identity phase
